general_information.Description: The course is intended for those undergraduate students in the Finance and Banking major. This course is designed to further develop the student’s understanding of the banking environment. The course introduces basic knowledge of commercial banks and their services and financial statements. It also helps the student obtain a thorough understanding of deposit base, lending, and the policies and procedures of each of these areas. Emphasis is also placed upon the areas of new legislation, regulation, financial market, deposits, and lending.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

assessments.Question Type: Students should attend all the sessions and actively participate in class discussion for full credit.
assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The question will cover the learned lectures, class discussions, activities, exercises, and textbook.

assessments.No Question: Maximum length of the group written report after the presentation should be 15 pages maximum excluding appendices
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied chapters
assessments.Note: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Evaluation will be based on both presentation (10%) and written report (15%)

assessments.Question Type: Students are required to choose a bank in Vietnam to analyse its financial position, risk management system, and investment strategies.
assessments.Note: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy in about 7-10 pages excluding appendices. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission; The deadline for individual assignment submission is noticed in the syllabus schedule.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Quizzes will test for knowledge of subjects in the chapter assigned for that day.
assessments.Note: These quizzes will be given at various times during class (beginning, middle or end). Total number of quizzes: 4
